description.value: Gyu-Kaku is a Japanese BBQ chain where diners grill their own meats and vegetables at table-mounted charcoal grills. The Vancouver location sits in the heart of downtown near Robson Street, convenient for cyclists exploring the city core. À la carte, course, lunch, and vegetarian menus are all available, with takeout also on offer.
